verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's developer portal documents official SDKs for Snapdragon X-series PCs: Arm-native Windows toolchains, the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, and Qualcomm AI Hub for deploying models to the Hexagon NPU. AI Hub adds the open-source GenieX runtime, model conversion to Qualcomm AI Runtime, ONNX Runtime and LiteRT, and sample app repositories. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that these SDKs support X2 Elite Extreme specifically (the evidence says X-series generally), in-depth SDK reference or API documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against them.
